name: ward-announcements
description: An installable app for a ward's announcements, sacrament meeting program and resources, with weekly push notifications

scripts.assets: npm run icons && npm run vendor
scripts.dev: npm run assets && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run assets && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.test:worker: npm run assets && TEST_TARGET=worker node --test test/access-gate.test.js test/attachments.test.js test/programs.test.js test/hardening.test.js test/roles.test.js test/passkeys.test.js test/passkeys-uv.test.js test/ward-settings.test.js && TEST_TARGET=worker TEST_WRANGLER_CONFIG=test/wrangler.r2.jsonc node --test test/attachments.test.js
scripts.host:deploy: ICON_MASK=chapel-mask.png npm run assets && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.host.production.jsonc
scripts.test:host: npm run assets && TEST_TARGET=worker TEST_WRANGLER_CONFIG=test/wrangler.host.jsonc node --test test/access-gate.test.js test/attachments.test.js test/programs.test.js test/hardening.test.js test/roles.test.js test/passkeys.test.js test/passkeys-uv.test.js test/ward-settings.test.js && TEST_TARGET=worker TEST_WRANGLER_CONFIG=test/wrangler.host-r2.jsonc node --test test/attachments.test.js && node --test --test-concurrency=3 test/host/*.test.js

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The owner's password for the `/admin` dashboard: the way in on a fresh deployment, and the way back if every passkey is lost. Everyone else is added from the dashboard and signs in with their own passkey. Use a long passphrase (12+ characters).

APP_NAME.description: Your ward's name as members see it: page title, header and install steps, e.g. `Example Ward`.

APP_SHORT_NAME.description: Label under the home-screen icon. Keep it to about 12 characters, e.g. `Example`.

APP_DESCRIPTION.description: One-line summary shown in link previews and the app manifest.

BACKUP_SEAL_KEY.description: Optional secret that seals the push keys inside the dashboard's backup, so a backup restored here keeps every member's notifications and the file alone cannot send. 32 random bytes, base64url (`npm run vapid` prints one). Leave blank and the backup leaves the keys out.

TZ.description: Your ward's timezone, for the weekly notification, e.g. `America/Denver`, `America/New_York`, `America/Los_Angeles`.

DB.description: The database for announcements, programs, images and subscriptions. Created for you.
